describe: The image shows a grey-green chaingun-style weapon seen from the side, with a perforated barrel housing on the left, a round drum magazine with a pale star-shaped hub at the lower left, and a grey-green pistol grip at the lower right. A dark slot and a yellow-tan curved piece sit at the top. The metal is muted grey-green and grey-white, lit from above with darker shadows underneath, and the edges are soft and noisy. Grey background around the weapon.
